[[File:Silvestri_-_Opus_novum_praefectis_arcium_-_4701899.tif|thumb|''Opus novum praefectis arcium'']]
'''Jacopo Silvestri''' was an Italian [[Cryptography|cryptographer]] and author active in the early 16th century.<ref name="cerl">{{Cite web|url=http://thesaurus.cerl.org/record/cnp01240010|title=Silvestri, Jacopo|website=thesaurus.cerl.org|access-date=2017-11-07}}</ref><ref name="arnold">{{Cite journal|doi=10.1080/0161-118091854942|first=Philip M.|last=Arnold|date=1980-04-01|title=An Apology for Jacopo Silvestri|journal=Cryptologia|volume=4|pages = 96–103|number=2}}</ref>

He was a citizen of the [[Republic of Florence]].<ref name="clemens">{{cite book |author=Clemens pp. VII |author-link=Clement VII |title=Opus novum praefectis arcium |location=Rome |year=1526 |page=44 |url=https://preserver.beic.it/delivery/DeliveryManagerServlet?dps_pid=IE5966041 |language=la}}</ref> Little is known about his life; his {{lang|la-x-new|Opus novum}} {{gloss|mode=def|"New work"}} provides some information about him and his work, and is considered the second printed work about [[cryptography]].<ref name="arnold"/><ref name="EllisonKim2017">{{cite book|chapter=Introduction: Ciphers and the Material History of Literacy|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=g641DwAAQBAJ&pg=PT43|title=A Material History of Medieval and Early Modern Ciphers: Cryptography and the History of Literacy|editor-first1=Katherine|editor-last1=Ellison|editor-first2=Susan|editor-last2=Kim|publisher=Taylor & Francis|year=2018|isbn=978-1-315-26744-9|at=p. 12, note 40}}</ref>
